sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Reflects blood glucose exposure over roughly two to three months.
high: An elevated A1C may reflect higher average glucose; diagnostic confirmation requires clinical assessment.
caveats: Red-cell disorders, kidney or liver disease and pregnancy may affect interpretation. This entry supplies no diagnostic threshold, individualized target or gestational-diabetes diagnosis.
